They may also have difficulty concentrating. They can also be more forgetful and feel tense, sad, or angry. Sometimes, people under stress may have poor eating habits and may use tobacco and alcohol more than usual. Some people may sleep too little or too much. This should include information which can be incorporated into existing first-aid procedures in the school. By creating individualized school health care plans for all students at school, teachers become more aware of these plans and health-related information for students, thus better prepared for an in-school medical emergency. By establishing in-school emergency procedures, in advance of an emergency, staff can respond more efficiently and assure more timely response to the student. Medical emergencies in schools are varied, but may include:
Anaphylaxis (severe allergic reaction)
Epileptic seizure/convulsions
When the student needs to go home immediately and a parent or guardian cannot be reached.
When the student should go home immediately and is refusing, a designated staff member should accompany the student home and remain until a parent, guardian or responsible adult is present.
Any injury requiring more care than the school can provide without seeking professional medical care.
Any injury requiring stitches, a cast, or in the case of a head injury, possible further damage, the local medical facility should be called, the student driven there by school personnel, and a parent or guardian contacted.

Artisanal gold mining in Central African Republic is booming. The benefit of the activity is the recovery of gold. Although not all miners are aware, mercury (Hg) is often used to form the amalgam from the ore. Through the Amalgamation Process between gold ore containing Au and elemental Hg will produce an amalgam which contains Au. The amalgam will then be heated until the Hg evaporates and leaves behind the Au. The amalgam process is a long-standing method in gold mining which is carried out using Hg (Kusnadi et al., 2016). Even so, the amalgamation process is a process that is very detrimental to the health of miners because it is toxic (Daimon et al., 2003). The use of Hg in mining activities is not used in accordance with the guidelines given by the government or does not meet the requirements for handling.
